title: Brake Failure in Reportedly AI-Driven Tram Leads to Multiple Injuries in Saint Petersburg, Russia

behaviors.text: During a test run in Saint Petersburg in Russia a reportedly AI-powered "Smart Tram" failed, leading to a crash that injured several [person] and trapped a woman under its wheels.
The tram's AI system reportedly shut off unexpectedly, and both primary and emergency brakes failed despite pre-test checks.
